entries.title: Psalms 142:1
segments: ¶<<A Contemplation of David. A Prayer when he was in the cave.>> I cry out to the LORD with my voice; With my voice to the LORD I make my supplication.

entries.title: Psalms 142:2
segments: I pour out my complaint before Him; I declare before Him my trouble.

entries.title: Psalms 142:3
segments: When my spirit was overwhelmed within me, Then You knew my path. In the way in which I walk They have secretly set a snare for me.

entries.title: Psalms 142:4
segments: ¶Look on [my] right hand and see, For [there is] no one who acknowledges me; Refuge has failed me; No one cares for my soul.

entries.title: Psalms 142:5
segments: I cried out to You, O LORD: I said, "You [are] my refuge, My portion in the land of the living.

entries.title: Psalms 142:6
segments: Attend to my cry, For I am brought very low; Deliver me from my persecutors, For they are stronger than I.

entries.title: Psalms 142:7
segments: Bring my soul out of prison, That I may praise Your name; The righteous shall surround me, For You shall deal bountifully with me."
